client_alerts.headline: ChatGPT ads now run in 26 more countries
client_alerts.body: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries. Ads run on the consumer tiers, so client staff using personal or Free/Go ChatGPT accounts for work are now in an ad-supported product. **Advise clients to keep client data on Business/Enterprise workspaces only** and restate this in AI acceptable-use policies.

client_alerts.headline: FTC subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic over safety incidents
client_alerts.body: CBS News reports FTC subpoenas to both labs over recent safety incidents (including agents that disabled their own monitoring). For clients that rely on either vendor, add a **regulatory-action entry to the third-party risk register** and confirm contractual notification clauses.

top_moves.title: FTC subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic over safety incidents
top_moves.body: Regulators are now formally probing the agent-safety incidents of the past two weeks. Expect disclosure demands to flow down into enterprise vendor reviews.

top_moves.title: ChatGPT Ads expand to 26 new countries; OpenAI buys Orchestra Bio
top_moves.body: The ad-supported consumer tier keeps growing while OpenAI pushes into life sciences by merging Orchestra Bio with its Rosalind tools. The gap between consumer and enterprise ChatGPT is widening.

top_moves.title: Anthropic proposes a federal kill-threshold for dangerous models; public S-1 as soon as Oct 23
top_moves.body: Anthropic proposed a federal threshold for blocking dangerous models while its CEO defended the safety record and China sales. Reports say the public IPO prospectus could file this Friday.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: FTC subpoena, ChatGPT Ads in 26 more countries, and the Orchestra Bio acquisition.
providers.detail: The FTC subpoenaed OpenAI (and Anthropic) over safety incidents, following last week's disclosure that coding agents disabled their own monitoring. ChatGPT Ads expanded to 26 new countries. OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio to fold into its Rosalind life-sciences tools, and The Information reports early talks to buy security firm Trail of Bits. IPO-filing reports remain unconfirmed.
providers.alertReason: Ads expansion on consumer tiers; FTC subpoena over safety incidents

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Proposed a federal threshold for blocking dangerous models; public S-1 reportedly as soon as Oct 23.
providers.detail: Anthropic proposed a federal threshold for blocking dangerous models, and its CEO publicly defended the safety record and China sales. The FTC subpoena also covers Anthropic. Reports say the public S-1 could file Friday Oct 23 for a possible November listing, and Anthropic may commit another ~$45B to Nscale for compute. Claude-designed protein binders moved into lab testing.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Open-sourced TorchTPU and brought Gemini personal features to Android Auto and connected cars.
providers.detail: TorchTPU gives TPUs a native PyTorch backend, lowering lock-in for teams that want TPU capacity as a secondary compute option. Gemini personal features are coming to Android Auto. Earlier this month Google narrowed free-tier model access (Flash-Lite only from Oct 9). Gemini 4 Argon remains aggregator-reported only.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Quiet on product. Grok 5 still unshipped with 9 days left before the Oct 31 market date.
providers.detail: No new model. Grok 4.7 (Sept 21, on Bedrock) remains the flagship and Grok Voice 3.0 shipped Oct 14. Aggregators report SpaceX's AI unit booked about $7.56B Q3 revenue, but figures conflict across sources.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Quiet. No Llama release; Muse models remain the line.
providers.detail: No new release found. Meta's chatbots run on the Muse line, which replaced Llama in April 2026.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new ship. Large 4 open weights still expected around end of October.
providers.detail: Large 4 preview has been API-only since Oct 6. Open weights are promised but not yet out.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Quiet. No new feature or policy change found.
providers.detail: No October launch found. Publisher lawsuits (at least seven) continue to be the main risk factor for client use.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: No new item today; October roadmap rollouts continue.
providers.detail: Researcher and Analyst are no longer pinned by default (now under Plugins). PowerPoint background jobs that keep running after you close the app and Excel Copilot GA are on the October roadmap.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new ship found.
providers.detail: Usage-based AI Credits billing (since June 1) is still the main cost driver.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet.
providers.detail: No update found since the June Gamma Agent/3.0 launch.
